transcript.text:
Hi everyone. Thanks for being here. As we all know, I've got the box of Aaron's reel-to-reel recordings, and some of the tapes are already starting to deteriorate. We need to figure out a preservation and access plan so the family can keep listening to these stories and music rehearsals.

Before I commit to anything, my usual practice is to check practical details and wishes with Theo and Lina. So I'd like to invite each of you to give a concrete suggestion for each of three areas: copying the recordings, storing the copies, and access for relatives who want to listen later.

Once we have a workable proposal for each of those three areas, I'll write up the family plan right away. We don't need to sort out every detail like file formats or online platforms before settling — just a concrete commitment for copying, storage, and access.

So let's start: who has a suggestion for how we should handle copying the recordings?
